pages.text: $(item)Dimensional Shard Ore$() can be found underground in small clusters in various dimensions. It is affected by $(thing)Fortune$(), and drops $(item)Dimensional Shards$() when broken. $(br2)These are used in several more complicated recipes, and can also be used to $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/infusing)infuse machines$().
Some Dimensional Shard Ore underground in the Overworld.
$(item)Dimensional Shards$() can also be used for the creation of a variety of $(item)Decorative Blocks$().
If you had RFTools Dimensions, you could make some pretty cool decorative blocks, but you can't, oh well :(
Use a Stonecutter to turn Dimensional Pattern 1 blocks into Dimensional Pattern 2 blocks. JEI shows the recipe.
Use a Stonecutter to turn Dimensional Cross blocks into Dimensional Cross 2 blocks. JEI shows the recipe.
